objective: Replace synthetic-looking visible media and convert launch/shipwreck map dots into linked, trustworthy decision and story insights without weakening canonical ownership, safety boundaries, privacy, or the existing record-rich parent pages.

baseline.note: Structural baseline of the just-merged release: the root hero appeared synthetic; launch popups exposed name/lake/regional observations but no persistent decision card; shipwreck markers exposed only a regional label and record count. This is a build-quality baseline, not a traffic forecast.

dimensions.note: Visible root hero is replaced at runtime with a traceable CC BY real Michigan launch photograph and visible attribution. Five points remain lost because the old local fallback/social image still exists in static HTML.

fatalPenalties: The displayed Boat Launch Finder root hero remains generated/synthetic or lacks traceable real-photo provenance and visible attribution.
A boat marker is presented as a launch safety rating or its regional NDBC station as ramp/harbor truth.
A shipwreck regional anchor is represented as an exact wreck, navigation, or dive coordinate.
Marker interactions remain decorative/count-only with no linked underlying record or useful next action.
Either parent canonical changes, thin child URLs are created, precise/personal location data is collected, or Circle Tour PR #51 is modified.
nextLossRemoval: Replace the static root hero/og:image fallback with the same documented real photograph in a future source-safe static media change; do not block the insight release on that non-visible fallback.
